feed.headline: Higgins brought in two of four targets for 22 yards in the Bengals' 31-24 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
feed.description: Higgins brought in two of four targets for 22 yards in the Bengals' 31-24 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
feed.story: Higgins was able to work through groin and neck injuries to suit up Sunday, but the veteran field-stretching receiver wasn't called on to do much on an afternoon when Joe Burrow threw for a season-low 192 yards. Nevertheless, Higgins seemingly made it through the game unscathed -- albeit with season-low totals across the board -- and he'll now have a Week 6 bye to further recover before a Week 7 road matchup against the Ravens on Sunday, Oct. 25.

feed.headline: Higgins (groin/neck) is active for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.
feed.description: Higgins (groin/neck) is active for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.
feed.story: After exiting last week's loss to Jacksonville due to what the Bengals initially referred to as an adductor injury, Higgins ended up appearing on the team's initial Week 5 injury report as a non-participant on account of groin and neck issues. He remained sidelined for practice Thursday before upgrading to full participation Friday and carrying a questionable tag into the weekend. Higgins apparently checked out fine following his pregame workout and has been given the green light to suit up Sunday along with fellow starting wideout Ja'Marr Chase (concussion), who had also been listed as questionable heading into the day. Cameron Wolfe of NFL Network relays the Bengals plan to monitor Higgins' snap count, but the wideout is still slated to take the field for mostly "meaningful plays," which could suggest he'll be given more frequent breaks from running plays where he would serve as a blocker.

feed.headline: Higgins (groin/neck) is expected to play Sunday in Miami, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
feed.description: Higgins (groin/neck) is expected to play Sunday in Miami, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
feed.story: Higgins emerged from Week 4 with adductor and neck injuries and wasn't able to practice at all Wednesday or Thursday, but he ended the week with a full session and entered the weekend listed as questionable to suit up. Fellow WR Ja'Marr Chase similarly was a full participant Friday and listed as questionable for Week 5 action, but he also is in line to be available to the Bengals offense Sunday. The statuses of both players will be confirmed about 90 minutes before a 1:00 p.m. ET kickoff.

feed.headline: Higgins (groin/neck) was a full practice participant Friday but is still listed as questionable for Sunday's game at Miami, Paul Dehner Jr. of The Athletic reports.
feed.description: Higgins (groin/neck) was a full practice participant Friday but is still listed as questionable for Sunday's game at Miami, Paul Dehner Jr. of The Athletic reports.
feed.story: Higgins didn't practice Wednesday or Thursday and wasn't spotted by media at the start of Friday's session. He apparently did enough to get an 'FP' designation on the final injury report, along with teammate Ja'Marr Chase, who also is listed as questionable and will need to clear concussion protocol. Things are looking up for both at the end of the week, but fantasy managers still will need to monitor the situation ahead of a 1:00 p.m. ET kickoff Sunday.

feed.headline: Higgins (groin/neck) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, Paul Dehner Jr. of The Athletic reports.
feed.description: Higgins (groin/neck) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, Paul Dehner Jr. of The Athletic reports.
feed.story: Higgins "practiced some" Friday, according to coach Zac Taylor, after the wideout logged back-to-back DNPs Wednesday and Thursday. Higgins eventually was a full participant to end the week. With Ja'Marr Chase still in the concussion protocol, he's also questionable for Week 5, putting the Bengals' wideout situation in a state of emergency. If neither can go against Miami, Cincinnati will lean on Dohnte Meyers and Mitchell Tinsley while Chase Brown and Mike Gesicki become focal points of the offense.

feed.headline: Higgins (groin/neck) was not taking part in Friday's stretching portion of practice, Ben Baby of ESPN.com reports.
feed.description: Higgins (groin/neck) was not taking part in Friday's stretching portion of practice, Ben Baby of ESPN.com reports.
feed.story: After logging non-participant listings Wednesday and Thursday, Higgins now appears to be trending toward another missed practice. Meanwhile, Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) looks to be taking part again.

feed.headline: Higgins (groin/neck) was a non-participant in Thursday's practice.
feed.description: Higgins (groin/neck) was a non-participant in Thursday's practice.
feed.story: Higgins was seen working out off to the side during the open portion of Thursday's session, and he apparently wasn't able to mix into team drills once practice was closed to the media. The veteran wideout has now had consecutive absences from practice to kick off Week 5 prep, while No. 1 receiver Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) bumped up to limited participation Thursday after sitting out Wednesday. The Bengals will see if Higgins and Chase can increase their practice activity Friday before deciding if either or both wideouts will carry designations into Sunday's game against the Dolphins.

feed.headline: Higgins (groin/neck) was spotted working out on a side field during the open portion of Thursday's practice, Ben Baby of ESPN.com reports.
feed.description: Higgins (groin/neck) was spotted working out on a side field during the open portion of Thursday's practice, Ben Baby of ESPN.com reports.
feed.story: Higgins emerged from a Week 4 loss to the Jaguars with an adductor issue, and Wednesday's practice report attributed his absence to both that injury and a neck problem. Considering he isn't in pads one day later, he seems destined to be a non-participant for a second session in a row, giving him just one more chance to mix into drills this week. Meanwhile, fellow wideout Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) returned to practice Thursday, though his activity level isn't known.

feed.headline: Higgins didn't practice Wednesday due to groin and neck injuries, Jay Morrison of SI.com reports.
feed.description: Higgins didn't practice Wednesday due to groin and neck injuries, Jay Morrison of SI.com reports.
feed.story: Head coach Zac Taylor suggested earlier Wednesday that Higgins would be a limited participant in the Bengals' first Week 5 session, but the wideout ended up being held out completely. Fellow wideout Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) also sat out practice, while rookie Colbie Young returned to the field in limited fashion. Higgins' status for Sunday's game against the Dolphins will be under the microscope as the week progresses.

feed.headline: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor said that Higgins (adductor) will be a limited participant in practice Wednesday, Paul Dehner Jr. of The Athletic reports.
feed.description: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor said that Higgins (adductor) will be a limited participant in practice Wednesday, Paul Dehner Jr. of The Athletic reports.
feed.story: After Taylor labeled Higgins as day-to-day earlier in the week, the wideout's ability to practice in any capacity to begin Week 5 prep is a positive sign for his chances of playing Sunday against the Dolphins. If Higgins is available this weekend, he could be in line to serve as the Bengals' No. 1 wideout, as the status of Ja'Marr Chase remains murky while he's in the concussion protocol. Receiver Dohnte Meyers and tight end Mike Gesicki would be next in line for targets behind Higgins.
